$comment: Corrections to the vendored dashboard.jsonschema.json (foundation-sdk v0.0.20), applied before type generation and GRAF107. Each patch cites the line of Grafana's source it follows, at the tag in `grafana`; CUE paths are kinds/dashboard/dashboard_kind.cue unless the source says otherwise. See src/spec/overlay.ts and docs/pages/schema-pin.mdx.

patches.why: Only schemaVersion is required; templating and annotations are optional (`templating?`, `annotations?`).

value.description: ID of a dashboard imported from the https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/ portal. A string in Grafana 12.4, an integer in 13.x; grafana.com downloads carry null.

patches.source: kinds/dashboard/dashboard_kind.cue:36 (int64 at v13.2.2, string at v12.4.0)
patches.why: The pin says string only; 13.x says int64, and community dashboards write null.

value.description: Inputs the importer asks for (datasources, constants). Written by "Export for sharing externally".

patches.source: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts:44-66; kinds/dashboard/dashboard_kind.cue:17 (spec is a plain struct, open)
patches.why: UI exports carry export metadata the foundation-sdk schema closes out.

value.description: Plugins and the Grafana version the export needs. Written by "Export for sharing externally".

name.description: Placeholder name, used as `${name}` in the dashboard.

value.description: The value a constant input carries.
One entry of an export's `__inputs`.

patches.why: Definition for __inputs entries.

value.description: One entry of an export's `__requires`.

patches.why: Definition for __requires entries.

model.description: The library panel's own panel JSON.

value.description: One library panel embedded in an export's `__elements`.

patches.why: Definition for __elements entries.
A library panel reference ({ id, gridPos, libraryPanel }) has no `type`; Grafana fills it from the library element. The anyOf below keeps one of the two required.
A panel names its plugin `type` or references a library panel.

The CUE says [...#DashboardLink], but Grafana's panel editor writes the DataLink subset ({ title, url, targetBlank }) and every UI export carries it. PanelLink keeps DashboardLink's fields with only `title` required.

title.description: Title to display with the link

targetBlank.description: If true, the link will be opened in a new tab

value.description: A panel link: the fields Grafana's panel link editor writes, plus DashboardLink's.

patches.why: Definition for panel links.

value.description: The behavior when clicking on a result

patches.why: The CUE says `links?: [...]` (any items); the pin requires every DashboardLink field on data links.

url.description: Link URL. Supports data variables, e.g. ${__field.labels.pod}.

internal.description: A query in another datasource (Explore link).

value.description: A data link on a field. Open: the CUE leaves these items unconstrained.

patches.why: Types field links as Grafana's DataLink while accepting anything, as the CUE does.
asDropdown, targetBlank, includeVars and keepTime carry CUE defaults (`bool | *false`), so a link may leave them out.

value.description: The source that registered the link (if any)

patches.why: New in Grafana 13.
New in Grafana 13 (#DatasourceControlSourceRef).
New in Grafana 13.

value.description: If set, limits this matcher to fields of that type. If not set, "series" mode is used.

patches.why: New in Grafana 13.

value.description: The matcher options. This is specific to the matcher implementation: a field name for byName, a pattern for byRegexp, an object for byNames or byValue.

patches.why: The CUE says `options?: _`; byName, byRegexp, byType and byFrameRefID take a string.
The CUE says `value?: _`; override values are strings, numbers, booleans and arrays as often as objects.

value.description:
Options to be passed to the transformer
Valid options depend on the transformer id

patches.why: The CUE says `options: _`.
The base step's value is -Infinity, which JSON cannot hold; Grafana's exports leave `value` out of that step.

value.description: Optional dashboard-variable expression (e.g. `$myVar`) resolved at render time; `value` is the numeric fallback when the expression cannot be resolved to a single finite number.

patches.why: New in Grafana 13.

value.description: Query used to fetch values for a variable: a string, or the datasource's own query object (Prometheus writes { query, qryType, refId }).

patches.why: The CUE says `string | {...}`; the pin requires every value of the object to be an object.

value.description: Shows current selected variable text/value on the dashboard. `{}` before the variable has been resolved.

patches.why: Grafana writes `current: {}` for a datasource or query variable nothing has been selected in yet.

value.description: Whether the group-by operator is enabled in the ad hoc filter combobox.

patches.why: New in Grafana 13.

value.description: Whether a custom variable defines its values as CSV or JSON.

patches.why: In the CUE since 12.4, missing from the pin.

value.description: Whether regex applies to the variable value or its display text.

patches.why: In the CUE since 12.4, missing from the pin.

value.description: Ad hoc variable: the filters currently applied.
